failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED as a self-consistency control, and IT FOUND A DISAGREEMENT THE FILE MAKES ABOUT ITSELF. Recomputed the node_type census against the declared counts block: ACTUAL C2Motif = 6,157 and C3System = 4 (6,161 nodes total), while the file declares c2_motif_instances_distinct = 6,138. ⛔ A 19-NODE GAP BETWEEN THE ARRAY AND THE TALLY, IN THE SAME FILE. The file's own _tally_denominator note explains the tally counts DISTINCT INSTANCES POST-COLLAPSE and not rows_seen -- and 6,657 rows_seen minus 519 collapsed = 6,138 exactly, so the tally is internally consistent with its stated definition. The array is simply a different population: it also carries class_nodes_marked_grain_class = 23. ⛔ THE CONSEQUENCE FOR A CONSUMER: counting len([n for n in nodes if node_type=='C2Motif']) gives 6,157 and reading counts.c2_motif_instances_distinct gives 6,138, BOTH FROM THIS FILE, both defensible, differing silently. That is the same class/instance grain collision 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~X carded on C2 from the graph side, corroborated here from the artifact side with different numbers and a different instrument.

verdict.why: A genuinely well-instrumented artifact -- it declares its producer, its lineage, its vintage, a 15-field counts block and a coverage triple, which is more self-description than any other subject this lane carded. It is UNSOUND on TRUST for three measured reasons: its array and its own tally disagree by 19 nodes with nothing marking which is authoritative; its ids resolve against a snapshot that is no longer the pinned one, with graph_nodes_total recorded NULL; and 5,851 KNOWLEDGE-side nodes sit at 0.0% coverage with in_detector_scope 0, meaning no detector could ever reach them. ⛔ NOTHING HERE SPEAKS TO THIS ARTIFACT'S FUTURE.
